verdict.rationale: Vendor docs explicitly list dedicated framework pages/support for SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI DSS, plus CMMC/NIST 800-171, all on the same platform with shared evidence collection, monitoring, and policy features. Missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration that customers actually run multiple frameworks simultaneously on one account without added tooling, and detail on how framework-specific controls overlap or require separate setup effort.
